ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; the fluke surface is characterized by a high density of low-intensity (dark) pixels with negligible high-intensity (white) distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, centrally-located U-shaped notch dividing the lobes with a narrow angular vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude deviations (serrations) forming a jagged profile along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-vertical, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the mid-to-outer section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and ragged margins along the trailing edge, particularly visible as jagged indentations on the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pointed and elongated lateral tips (fluke corners) exceeding typical curvature.
